channel.title: GNUton's Merlin Builds — Guides
channel.description: GNUton's builds extend Asuswrt-Merlin to more ASUS routers. WiFi 7, WiFi 6 and DSL firmware, supported by ASUS and RMerlin, built in the cloud and open source.

item.title: Which router version do I have?
item.description: Hardware revisions matter. Here is how to read the model name and confirm the exact revision before downloading a firmware image.

item.title: Understanding the 3006, 3004 and 386 branches
item.description: GNUton's builds follow ASUS firmware generations. This is what the branch number means and why you cannot cross-flash between them.

item.title: How to flash GNUton's firmware
item.description: A careful, generic flashing checklist for ASUS routers running GNUton's Asuswrt-Merlin builds, from backup to post-flash verification.

item.title: Repeater Mode on the experimental 386 build
item.description: The DSL-AC68U has an experimental build that restores Repeater Mode. Here is what it is, who it helps, and why AiMesh is usually the better choice.

item.title: Ways to help the builds
item.description: You do not need to write kernel patches to contribute. Testing, clear bug reports, documentation and community support all move the project forward.
